tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Pesupanda price list (dry cleaning, laundry, ironing, carpets, courier). Prices in EUR incl. VAT.

tools.name: get_opening_hours
tools.description: Opening hours of the Mustamäe and Haabersti service points in Tallinn, including public holidays on a given date.

tools.name: check_courier_area
tools.description: Check whether the laundry courier serves a district or settlement (give the district/settlement name, not a street address).

tools.name: get_courier_slots
tools.description: Free laundry courier pickup times for the next 7 days (or one given date), same rules as the online order form: working days, public holidays, booking cut-off and capacity. Some time windows serve only certain areas (area_limited). Booking is done on the order page (order_url).

tools.name: get_business_info
tools.description: Company details: addresses, phone, e-mail, registry code, opening hours.
